name: Kawasaki Tomoka
source:
She is a saleswoman who joined the company in the same year as Ayana. She is a frivolous and H-loving office worker.

She used to make fun of the main character, but once she got physical with him under the effect of an aphrodisiac,  she started to invite him out...?

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/5638]official site[/url]]
